notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/795fd9fac8b8795dfddc7067a6c20f884b93b51c.png[/img]

[b]Patch notes 1.0.9:[/b]
-Significantly reduced size of log file
-Fixed an issue that caused the physics to not be properly applied to the "Tropical Blossom" costume

Additionally we are seeing some comments about rare crashes that may happen during the game. Please, if you encounter such crashes on your device, send us link to your log file uploaded to Google Drive, Onedrive or you can join our Discord server and send the log file there ([url=https://discord.gg/bWsKmxqFXq]https://discord.gg/bWsKmxqFXq[/url]). This would help us a lot to identify what's causing the issue as we are unable to reproduce the bug on our side.

Log file ("Player.log") is located under the path: C:\Users\{your_username}\AppData\LocalLow\Catthia Games\Cynthia Hidden in the Moonshadow

Thanks and have a nice day ː2017stickycrabː

notes.title: Cynthia Demo Patch 1.0.21
notes.content:
Hi there!

So many things have been changed since the last time so let's jump straight into the patch notes :)

[b]Demo Patch Notes 1.0.21:[/b]
-Added jump ability
-Added dodge ability
-From now on enemies can be shot
-Added sprint ability
-Added stamina bar
-Camera system is reworked - no more weird offsets and movements on Camera when aiming
-Bushes are now swapped to tall grass to improve clarity in which places Player can actually hide
-Control mapper window is reworked
-Lake puzzle is slightly reworked
-Uncle Diego finally fixed the bridge (New bridge model and no more weird cutscene)
-Small change in the loading UI
-Added new popup window to ensure that player want to start a new game when previous save file exist
-Added small tip in the crafting window
-Fixed issue with very high pitch sound
-Fixed issue with floaty aim, now should be more precise (Please let me know if there is any issue with sensitivity)

Wow that's quite a lot. There are more fixes and adjustments but these are the most important. Anyway stay healthy and to the next one ^^

notes.title: Cynthia Demo Patch 1.0.20
notes.content:
Hi there!

This one is quite big, so it took me longer to deliver :D but here are the changes.

[b]Demo Patch Notes 1.0.20:[/b]
-Brand new system to craft arrows - From now on Cynthia can craft arrows in campfire places which are scattered around the map. To craft arrows you need to collect some materials which should be quite easy to find.
-From now on Guards can hear your steps from a certain distance. I wouldn't recommend to run behind their backs :)
-Added new area below the bridge
-Some new pickup item sounds
-Added small secret interaction with four-legged... maybe you should find out by yourself :)
-Added visual indication when there are no more arrows left
-Fixed idle time trigger
-Fixed small issue with the UI
-Fixed bug with bridge disappearing under certain camera angle

Have a nice day! ^^

Tomasz here, bringing you another update to the demo of Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow. From now on I decided (ekhem thanks to Adam ^^) that I will try to post patch notes describing how game is evolving during the development process and what exactly is changing. Also as always I would like to thanks all of you for a constant support, it really means a lot and motivates me to work on this project.

Wishlist and stay tuned for more info :)
